fusions.name: Split the Row
fusions.desc: Looses 2 curved blades spread apart, each dealing 9 damage. Your afflictions on a target they hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Driven Through
fusions.desc: Drives a pronged blade into a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores armour and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Two-Way Parry
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Branching Stroke
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a second cut branches to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage, then to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
